extension.summary: A cinematic Kodi skin inspired by the glassy Apple TV 2026 desktop.
Ein cineastischer Kodi-Skin im Glas-Look des Apple-TV-2026-Desktops.
extension.description: xVAULT Liquid keeps the media art in focus with a full-screen promo slider, translucent controls, dock navigation, and a small service that refreshes current German series promo images from JustWatch.
xVAULT Liquid stellt Medienkunst in den Mittelpunkt: Vollbild-Promo-Slider, transluzente Bedienelemente, Dock-Navigation und ein kleiner Service fuer aktuelle deutsche Serienbilder von JustWatch.
extension.news: 0.1.8 - Declare install-time dependencies explicitly and validate repository dependency packaging during release builds.
